checks.name: Commit metadata and diffs remain inert text, including control separators
Renderer has no Node or raw IPC; unopened repositories are rejected
IPC from a foreign window is denied even with the application preload
CSP blocks inline scripts and renderer network requests
Electron session blocks HTTP before the local canary receives it
Notifications denied, renderer isolated and dictionary downloads disabled
Settings store only recent local paths and theme, without repository content
Popups and external navigation cannot leave the local application

note: Playwright uses --no-sandbox for Linux automation; this is not a production sandbox attestation.
